description: Use this when someone asks where one application stands: 'what is the status of my Dubai visa', 'ما حالة تأشيرتي لدبي؟', 'какой статус у моей визы в Таиланд', 'मेरे थाईलैंड वीज़ा की स्थिति क्या है?'. Status, completion, payment state and trip of one application, with the UI link to open it in the browser. When next_action is awaiting_payment, that page is where the account holder pays.
name: visarun_get_application
title: Get application status
